verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ מֵעִ֣יר עַל־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לֵ֣ב קָמָ֑י ר֖וּחַ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî mê·‘îr ‘al- bā·ḇel wə·’el- yō·šə·ḇê lêḇ qā·māy rū·aḥ maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Behold I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai . . . the spirit of a destroyer
verses.literalPt: ASSIM diz o SENHOR: Eis que levantarei um vento destruidor contra Babilônia, e contra os que habitam no meio dos que se levantam contra mim.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֤ל׀ זָרִים֙ וְזֵר֔וּהָ וִיבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî lə·ḇā·ḇel zā·rîm wə·zê·rū·hā wî·ḇō·qə·qū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣāh kî- hā·yū ‘ā·le·hā mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·yō·wm rā·‘āh
verses.literal: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster
verses.literalPt: E enviarei padejadores contra Babilônia, que a padejarão, e despejarão a sua terra; porque virão contra ela em redor no dia da calamidade.

verses.original: אֶֽל־ יִדְרֹ֤ךְ הַדֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְאֶל־ יִתְעַ֖ל בְּסִרְיֹנ֑וֹ וְאַֽל־ תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל־ בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔יהָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כָּל־ צְבָאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- yiḏ·rōḵ had·dō·rêḵ qaš·tōw wə·’el- yiṯ·‘al bə·sir·yō·nōw wə·’al- taḥ·mə·lū ’el- ba·ḥu·re·hā ha·ḥă·rî·mū kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’āh
verses.literal: Do not let the archer bend his bow or put on his armor . . . Do not spare . . . her young men devote all her army to destruction
verses.literalPt: O flecheiro arme o seu arco contra o que arma o seu arco, e contra o que se exalta na sua couraça; e não perdoeis aos seus jovens; destruí a todo o seu exército.

verses.original: וְנָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וּמְדֻקָּרִ֖ים בְּחוּצוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ḥă·lā·lîm bə·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm ū·mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm bə·ḥū·ṣō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans and pierced through in her streets
verses.literalPt: E os mortos cairão na terra dos caldeus, e atravessados nas suas ruas.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אַלְמָ֨ן יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ מֵֽאֱלֹהָ֔יו מֵֽיְהוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֤י אַרְצָם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִקְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ’al·mān yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh mê·’ĕ·lō·hāw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî ’ar·ṣām mā·lə·’āh ’ā·šām miq·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God the LORD of Hosts though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porque Israel e Judá não foram abandonados do seu Deus, do SENHOR dos Exércitos, ainda que a sua terra esteja cheia de culpas contra o Santo de Israel.

verses.original: נֻ֣סוּ׀ מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּמַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אַל־ תִּדַּ֖מּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּי֩ עֵ֨ת נְקָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה גְּמ֕וּל ה֥וּא מְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: nu·sū mit·tō·wḵ bā·ḇel ū·mal·lə·ṭū ’îš nap̄·šōw ’al- tid·dam·mū ba·‘ă·wō·nāh kî ‘êṯ nə·qā·māh hî Yah·weh gə·mūl hū mə·šal·lêm lāh
verses.literal: Flee from Babylon Escape with your lives Do not be destroyed in her punishment For this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance He will pay her what she deserves
verses.literalPt: Fugi do meio de Babilônia, e livrai cada um a sua alma, e não vos destruais na sua maldade; porque este é o tempo da vingança do SENHOR; que lhe dará a sua recompensa.

verses.original: כּוֹס־ זָהָ֤ב בָּבֶל֙ בְּיַד־ יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מִיֵּינָהּ֙ שָׁת֣וּ גוֹיִ֔ם עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יִתְהֹלְל֥וּ גוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kō·ws- zā·hāḇ bā·ḇel bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh mə·šak·ke·reṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ mî·yê·nāh šā·ṯū ḡō·w·yim ‘al- kên yiṯ·hō·lə·lū ḡō·w·yim
verses.literal: Babylon was a gold cup in the hand of the LORD making the whole earth drunk The nations drank her wine therefore . . . the nations have gone mad
verses.literalPt: Babilônia era um copo de ouro na mão do SENHOR, o qual embriagava a toda a terra; do seu vinho beberam as nações; por isso as nações enlouqueceram.

verses.original: פִּתְאֹ֛ם נָפְלָ֥ה בָבֶ֖ל וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ עָלֶ֗יהָ קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְמַכְאוֹבָ֔הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: piṯ·’ōm nā·p̄ə·lāh ḇā·ḇel wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr hê·lî·lū ‘ā·le·hā qə·ḥū ṣo·rî lə·maḵ·’ō·w·ḇāh ’ū·lay tê·rā·p̄ê
verses.literal: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered Wail for her get her balm for her pain perhaps she can be healed
verses.literalPt: Num momento caiu Babilônia, e ficou arruinada; lamentai por ela, tomai bálsamo para a sua dor, porventura sarará.

verses.original: רִפִּאנוּ אֶת־ בָּבֶל֙ וְלֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה עִזְב֕וּהָ וְנֵלֵ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ נָגַ֤ע אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔הּ וְנִשָּׂ֖א עַד־ שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rip·pi·nū ’eṯ- bā·ḇel wə·lō nir·pā·ṯāh ‘iz·ḇū·hā wə·nê·lêḵ ’îš lə·’ar·ṣōw kî- nā·ḡa‘ ’el- haš·šā·ma·yim miš·pā·ṭāh wə·niś·śā ‘aḏ- šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: We tried to heal Babylon but she could not be healed Abandon her Let each of us go to his own land for her judgment extends to the sky and reaches to the clouds
verses.literalPt: Queríamos curar Babilônia, porém ela não sarou; deixai-a, e vamo-nos cada um para a sua terra; porque o seu juízo chegou até ao céu, e se elevou até às mais altas nuvens.

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ בֹּ֚אוּ וּנְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְצִיּ֔וֹן אֶֽת־ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ṣî Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯê·nū bō·’ū ū·nə·sap·pə·rāh ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śêh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: The LORD has brought forth our vindication come let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR trouxe a nossa justiça à luz; vinde e contemos em Sião a obra do SENHOR, nosso Deus.

verses.original: הָבֵ֣רוּ הַחִצִּים֮ מִלְא֣וּ הַשְּׁלָטִים֒ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י כִּֽי־ עַל־ בָּבֶ֥ל מְזִמָּת֖וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ נִקְמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇê·rū ha·ḥiṣ·ṣîm mil·’ū haš·šə·lā·ṭîm hê·‘îr Yah·weh ’eṯ- rū·aḥ mal·ḵê mā·ḏay kî- ‘al- bā·ḇel mə·zim·mā·ṯōw lə·haš·ḥî·ṯāh kî- niq·maṯ Yah·weh hî niq·maṯ hê·ḵā·lōw
verses.literal: Sharpen the arrows Fill the quivers The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her for it is the vengeance of the LORD vengeance for His temple
verses.literalPt: Aguçai as flechas, preparai os escudos; o SENHOR despertou o espírito dos reis da Média; porque o seu intento é contra Babilônia para a destruir; porque esta é a vingança do SENHOR, a vingança do seu templo.

verses.original: אֶל־ חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ־ נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֙ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָאֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י גַּם־ זָמַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה גַּם־ עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- ḥō·w·mōṯ bā·ḇel śə·’ū- nês ha·ḥă·zî·qū ham·miš·mār hā·qî·mū šō·mə·rîm hā·ḵî·nū hā·’ō·rə·ḇîm kî gam- zā·mam Yah·weh gam- ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’el- yō·šə·ḇê ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: Raise a banner against the walls of Babylon post the guard station the watchmen prepare the ambush For the LORD has both devised and accomplished what He spoke against the people of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Arvorai um estandarte sobre os muros de Babilônia, reforçai a guarda, colocai sentinelas, preparai as ciladas; porque como o SENHOR intentou, assim fez o que tinha falado contra os moradores de Babilônia.

verses.original: שֹׁכַנְתִּי עַל־ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת בָּ֥א קִצֵּ֖ךְ אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·ḵan·tī ‘al- ma·yim rab·bîm rab·baṯ ’ō·w·ṣā·rōṯ bā qiṣ·ṣêḵ ’am·maṯ biṣ·‘êḵ
verses.literal: You who dwell by many waters rich in treasures your end has come the thread of your life is cut
verses.literalPt: Ó tu, que habitas sobre muitas águas, rica de tesouros, é chegado o teu fim, a medida da tua avareza.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־ מִלֵּאתִ֤יךְ אָדָם֙ כַּיֶּ֔לֶק וְעָנ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ הֵידָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: niš·ba‘ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·nap̄·šōw kî ’im- mil·lê·ṯîḵ ’ā·ḏām kay·ye·leq wə·‘ā·nū ‘ā·la·yiḵ hê·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts has sworn by Himself Surely . . . I will fill you up with men as with locusts and they will shout in triumph . . . over you
verses.literalPt: Jurou o SENHOR dos Exércitos por si mesmo, dizendo: Ainda que te enchi de homens, como de lagarta, contudo levantarão gritaria contra ti.

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ’e·reṣ bə·ḵō·ḥōw mê·ḵîn tê·ḇêl bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw nā·ṭāh šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: The LORD made the earth by His power He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding
verses.literalPt: Ele fez a terra com o seu poder, e ordenou o mundo com a sua sabedoria, e estendeu os céus com o seu entendimento.

verses.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵה־ אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·wl tit·tōw hă·mō·wn ma·yim baš·šā·ma·yim way·ya·‘al nə·śi·’îm miq·ṣêh- ’ā·reṣ bə·rā·qîm lam·mā·ṭār ‘ā·śāh way·yō·ṣê rū·aḥ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāw
verses.literal: When He thunders . . . the waters in the heavens roar He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses
verses.literalPt: Fazendo ele ouvir a sua voz, grande estrondo de águas há nos céus, e faz subir os vapores desde o fim da terra; faz os relâmpagos com a chuva, e tira o vento dos seus tesouros,

verses.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־ אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־ צֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·‘ar kāl- ’ā·ḏām mid·da·‘aṯ hō·ḇîš kāl- ṣō·rêp̄ mip·pā·sel kî še·qer nis·kōw wə·lō- rū·aḥ bām
verses.literal: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols For his molten images are a fraud and there is no breath in them
verses.literalPt: Embrutecido é todo o homem, no seu conhecimento; envergonha-se todo o artífice da imagem de escultura; porque a sua imagem de fundição é mentira, e nelas não há espírito.

verses.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: he·ḇel hêm·māh ma·‘ă·śêh ta‘·tu·‘îm bə·‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: They are worthless a work to be mocked In the time of their punishment they will perish
verses.literalPt: Vaidade são, obra de enganos; no tempo da sua visitação perecerão.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב כִּֽי־ יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְשֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵə·’êl·leh ḥê·leq ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ kî- yō·w·ṣêr hak·kōl hū wə·šê·ḇeṭ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: The Portion of Jacob is not like these for He is the Maker of all things and of the tribe of His inheritance the LORD of Hosts is His name
verses.literalPt: Não é semelhante a estes a porção de Jacó; porque ele é o que formou tudo; e Israel é a tribo da sua herança; o SENHOR dos Exércitos é o seu nome.

verses.original: מַפֵּץ־ אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔י כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִשְׁחַתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: map·pêṣ- ’at·tāh lî kə·lê mil·ḥā·māh wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā gō·w·yim wə·hiš·ḥat·tî ḇə·ḵā mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: You are My war club My weapon for battle With you I shatter nations with you I bring kingdoms to ruin
verses.literalPt: Tu és meu machado de batalha e minhas armas de guerra, e por meio de ti despedaçarei as nações e por ti destruirei os reis;

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ ס֖וּס וְרֹֽכְב֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ רֶ֖כֶב וְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā sūs wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā re·ḵeḇ wə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw
verses.literal: With you I shatter the horse and rider with you I shatter the chariot and driver
verses.literalPt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o cavalo e o seu cavaleiro; e por meio de ti despedaçarei o carro e o que nele vai;

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ זָקֵ֣ן וָנָ֑עַר וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ בָּח֖וּר וּבְתוּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā ’îš wə·’iš·šāh wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā zā·qên wā·nā·‘ar wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā bā·ḥūr ū·ḇə·ṯū·lāh
verses.literal: With you I shatter man and woman with you I shatter the old man and the youth with you I shatter the young man and the maiden
verses.literalPt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o homem e a mulher, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o velho e o moço, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o jovem e a virgem;

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ רֹעֶ֣ה וְעֶדְר֔וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ אִכָּ֣ר וְצִמְדּ֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ פַּח֖וֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā rō·‘eh wə·‘eḏ·rōw wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā ’ik·kār wə·ṣim·dōw wə·nip·paṣ·tî ḇə·ḵā pa·ḥō·wṯ ū·sə·ḡā·nîm
verses.literal: With you I shatter the shepherd and his flock with you I shatter the farmer and his oxen with you I shatter the governors and officials
verses.literalPt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o pastor e o seu rebanho, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o lavrador e a sua junta de bois, e por meio de ti despedaçarei os capitães e os magistrados.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כָּל־ רָעָתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֥וּ בְצִיּ֖וֹן לְעֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·lam·tî lə·ḇā·ḇel ū·lə·ḵōl yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḵaś·dîm ’êṯ kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea for all the evil they have done in Zion declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E pagarei a Babilônia, e a todos os moradores da Caldéia, toda a maldade que fizeram em Sião, aos vossos olhos, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ הַ֤ר הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה הַמַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְהַ֥ר שְׂרֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā har ham·maš·ḥîṯ nə·’um- Yah·weh ham·maš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·ḡil·gal·tî·ḵā min- has·sə·lā·‘îm ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·har śə·rê·p̄āh
verses.literal: Behold I am against you O destroying mountain you who devastate the whole earth declares the LORD I will stretch out My hand against you I will roll you over the cliffs and turn you into a charred mountain
verses.literalPt: Eis-me aqui contra ti, ó monte destruidor, diz o SENHOR, que destróis toda a terra; e estenderei a minha mão contra ti, e te revolverei das rochas, e farei de ti um monte de queima.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְפִנָּ֔ה וְאֶ֖בֶן לְמֽוֹסָד֑וֹת כִּֽי־ שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiq·ḥū mim·mə·ḵā ’e·ḇen lə·p̄in·nāh wə·’e·ḇen lə·mō·w·sā·ḏō·wṯ kî- šim·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone . . . or a foundation stone because you will become desolate forever declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E não tomarão de ti pedra para esquina, nem pedra para fundamentos, porque te tornarás em assolação perpétua, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַֽעֲלוּ־ ס֖וּס כְּיֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- nês bā·’ā·reṣ tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār bag·gō·w·yim qad·də·šū ‘ā·le·hā gō·w·yim haš·mî·‘ū ‘ā·le·hā mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ ’ă·rā·raṭ min·nî wə·’aš·kə·nāz piq·ḏū ‘ā·le·hā ṭip̄·sār ha·‘ă·lū- sūs kə·ye·leq sā·mār
verses.literal: Raise a banner in the land Blow the ram’s horn among the nations Prepare the nations against her Summon the kingdoms against her Ararat Minni and Ashkenaz Appoint a captain against her bring up horses like swarming locusts
verses.literalPt: Arvorai um estandarte na terra, tocai a buzina entre as nações, preparai as nações contra ela, convocai contra ela os reinos de Ararate, Mini, e Asquenaz; ordenai contra ela um capitão, fazei subir cavalos, como lagartas eriçadas.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת־ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת־ פַּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ סְגָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū ‘ā·le·hā ḡō·w·yim ’eṯ- mal·ḵê mā·ḏay ’eṯ- pa·ḥō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- kāl- sə·ḡā·ne·hā wə·’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: Prepare the nations for battle against her the kings of the Medes their governors and all their officials and all the lands they rule
verses.literalPt: Preparai contra ela as nações, os reis da Média, os seus capitães, e todos os seus magistrados, e toda a terra do seu domínio.

verses.original: וַתִּרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י קָ֤מָה עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־ אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְשַׁמָּ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tir·‘aš hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tā·ḥōl kî qā·māh ‘al- bā·ḇel maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ Yah·weh lā·śūm ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ bā·ḇel lə·šam·māh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD’s intentions against Babylon stand to make the land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant
verses.literalPt: Então tremerá a terra, e doer-se-á, porque cada um dos desígnios do SENHOR está firme contra Babilônia, para fazer da terra de Babilônia uma desolação, sem habitantes.

verses.original: חָדְלוּ֩ גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל לְהִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת נָשְׁתָ֥ה גְבוּרָתָ֖ם הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים הִצִּ֥יתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḏə·lū ḡib·bō·w·rê ḇā·ḇel lə·hil·lā·ḥêm yā·šə·ḇū bam·mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ nā·šə·ṯāh ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯām hā·yū lə·nā·šîm hiṣ·ṣî·ṯū miš·kə·nō·ṯe·hā niš·bə·rū ḇə·rî·ḥe·hā
verses.literal: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting they sit in their strongholds Their strength is exhausted they have become like women Babylon’s homes have been set ablaze the bars of her gates are broken
verses.literalPt: Os poderosos de Babilônia cessaram de pelejar, ficaram nas fortalezas, desfaleceu a sua força, tornaram-se como mulheres; incendiaram as suas moradas, quebrados foram os seus ferrolhos.

verses.original: רָ֤ץ לִקְרַאת־ רָץ֙ יָר֔וּץ וּמַגִּ֖יד לִקְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְהַגִּיד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי־ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה עִיר֖וֹ מִקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rāṣ liq·raṯ- rāṣ yā·rūṣ ū·mag·gîḏ liq·raṯ mag·gîḏ lə·hag·gîḏ lə·me·leḵ bā·ḇel kî- nil·kə·ḏāh ‘î·rōw miq·qā·ṣeh
verses.literal: One courier races to meet another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end
verses.literalPt: Um correio correrá ao encontro de outro correio, e um mensageiro ao encontro de outro mensageiro, para anunciar ao rei de Babilônia que a sua cidade está tomada de todos os lados.

verses.original: וְהַמַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְאֶת־ הָאֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·ma‘·bā·rō·wṯ niṯ·pā·śū wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḡam·mîm śā·rə·p̄ū ḇā·’êš wə·’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh niḇ·hā·lū
verses.literal: The fords have been seized the marshes set on fire . . . and the soldiers . . . are terrified
verses.literalPt: E os vaus estão ocupados, e os canaviais queimados a fogo; e os homens de guerra ficaram assombrados.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּת־ בָּבֶ֕ל כְּגֹ֖רֶן עֵ֣ת הִדְרִיכָ֑הּ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֔ט וּבָ֥אָה עֵֽת־ הַקָּצִ֖יר לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl baṯ- bā·ḇel kə·ḡō·ren ‘êṯ hiḏ·rî·ḵāh ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ ū·ḇā·’āh ‘êṯ- haq·qā·ṣîr lāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled In just a little while . . . her harvest time will come
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: A filha de Babilônia é como uma eira, no tempo da debulha; ainda um pouco, e o tempo da sega lhe virá.

verses.original: אֲכָלָנוּ הֲמָמָנוּ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶל֒ הִצִּיגָנוּ כְּלִ֣י רִ֔יק בְּלָעָנוּ כַּתַּנִּ֔ין מִלָּ֥א כְרֵשׂ֖וֹ מֵֽעֲדָנָ֑י הֱדִיחָנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾă·ḵå̄·lå̄·nū hă·må̄·må̄·nū nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel hiṣ·ṣī·ḡå̄·nū kə·lî rîq bə·lå̄·ʿå̄·nū kat·tan·nîn mil·lā ḵə·rê·śōw mê·‘ă·ḏā·nāy hɛ̆·ḏī·ḥå̄·nū
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me he has crushed me He has set me aside like an empty vessel he has swallowed me like a monster he filled his belly with my delicacies and vomited me out
verses.literalPt: Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, devorou-me, colocou-me de lado, fez de mim um vaso vazio, como chacal me tragou, encheu o seu ventre das minhas delicadezas; lançou-me fora.

verses.original: חֲמָסִ֤י וּשְׁאֵרִי֙ עַל־ בָּבֶ֔ל תֹּאמַ֖ר יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן וְדָמִי֙ אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים תֹּאמַ֖ר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mā·sî ū·šə·’ê·rî ‘al- bā·ḇel tō·mar yō·še·ḇeṯ ṣî·yō·wn wə·ḏā·mî ’el- yō·šə·ḇê ḵaś·dîm tō·mar yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon says the dweller of Zion May my blood be on the dwellers of Chaldea says Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: A violência que se fez a mim e à minha carne venha sobre Babilônia, dirá a moradora de Sião; e o meu sangue caia sobre os moradores da Caldéia, dirá Jerusalém.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי־ רָב֙ אֶת־ רִיבֵ֔ךְ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ נִקְמָתֵ֑ךְ וְהַחֲרַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יַמָּ֔הּ וְהֹבַשְׁתִּ֖י אֶת־ מְקוֹרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî- rāḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇêḵ wə·niq·qam·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯêḵ wə·ha·ḥă·raḇ·tî ’eṯ- yam·māh wə·hō·ḇaš·tî ’eṯ- mə·qō·w·rāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Behold I will plead your case and take vengeance on your behalf I will dry up her sea and make her springs run dry
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que pleitearei a tua causa, e tomarei vingança por ti; e secarei o seu mar, e farei que se esgote o seu manancial.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָה֩ בָבֶ֨ל׀ לְגַלִּ֧ים׀ מְעוֹן־ תַּנִּ֛ים שַׁמָּ֥ה וּשְׁרֵקָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·ḇel lə·ḡal·lîm mə·‘ō·wn- tan·nîm šam·māh ū·šə·rê·qāh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Babylon will become a heap of rubble a haunt for jackals an object of horror and scorn without inhabitant
verses.literalPt: E Babilônia se tornará em montões, morada de chacais, espanto e assobio, sem que haja quem nela habite.

verses.original: יַחְדָּ֖ו כַּכְּפִרִ֣ים יִשְׁאָ֑גוּ נָעֲר֖וּ כְּגוֹרֵ֥י אֲרָיֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·dāw kak·kə·p̄i·rîm yiš·’ā·ḡū nā·‘ă·rū kə·ḡō·w·rê ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: They will roar together like young lions they will growl like lion cubs
verses.literalPt: Juntamente rugirão como filhos dos leões; bramarão como filhotes de leões.

verses.original: בְּחֻמָּ֞ם אָשִׁ֣ית אֶת־ מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֗ם וְהִשְׁכַּרְתִּים֙ לְמַ֣עַן יַעֲלֹ֔זוּ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥum·mām ’ā·šîṯ ’eṯ- miš·tê·hem wə·hiš·kar·tîm lə·ma·‘an ya·‘ă·lō·zū wə·yā·šə·nū šə·naṯ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·lō yā·qî·ṣū nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: While they are flushed with heat I will serve them a feast and I will make them drunk so that they may revel then they will fall asleep . . . forever and never wake up declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Estando eles excitados, lhes darei a sua bebida, e os embriagarei, para que andem saltando; porém dormirão um perpétuo sono, e não acordarão, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: אֽוֹרִידֵ֖ם כְּכָרִ֣ים לִטְב֑וֹחַ כְּאֵילִ֖ים עִם־ עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·rî·ḏêm kə·ḵā·rîm liṭ·ḇō·w·aḥ kə·’ê·lîm ‘im- ‘at·tū·ḏîm
verses.literal: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter like rams with male goats
verses.literalPt: Fá-los-ei descer como cordeiros à matança, como carneiros e bodes.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה שֵׁשַׁ֔ךְ וַתִּתָּפֵ֖שׂ תְּהִלַּ֣ת כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ nil·kə·ḏāh šê·šaḵ wat·tit·tā·p̄êś tə·hil·laṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’êḵ hā·yə·ṯāh lə·šam·māh bā·ḇel bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: How Sheshach has been captured The praise of all the earth has been seized What a horror Babylon has become among the nations
verses.literalPt: Como foi tomada Sesaque, e apanhada de surpresa a glória de toda a terra! Como se tornou Babilônia objeto de espanto entre as nações!

verses.original: עָלָ֥ה עַל־ בָּבֶ֖ל הַיָּ֑ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹן גַּלָּ֖יו נִכְסָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāh ‘al- bā·ḇel hay·yām ba·hă·mō·wn gal·lāw niḵ·sā·ṯāh
verses.literal: The sea has come up over Babylon she is covered in turbulent waves
verses.literalPt: O mar subiu sobre Babilônia; com a multidão das suas ondas se cobriu.

verses.original: הָי֤וּ עָרֶ֙יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וַעֲרָבָ֑ה אֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא־ יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּהֵן֙ כָּל־ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ יַעֲבֹ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן בֶּן־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yū ‘ā·re·hā lə·šam·māh ’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh wa·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ’e·reṣ lō- yê·šêḇ bā·hên kāl- ’îš wə·lō- ya·‘ă·ḇōr bā·hên ben- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Her cities have become a desolation a dry and arid land a land where no . . . one lives where no son of man passes through . . .
verses.literalPt: Tornaram-se as suas cidades em desolação, terra seca e deserta, terra em que ninguém habita, nem passa por ela filho de homem.

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עַל־ בֵּ֜ל בְּבָבֶ֗ל וְהֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶת־ בִּלְעוֹ֙ מִפִּ֔יו וְלֹֽא־ יִנְהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו ע֖וֹד גּוֹיִ֑ם גַּם־ חוֹמַ֥ת בָּבֶ֖ל נָפָֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- bêl bə·ḇā·ḇel wə·hō·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- bil·‘ōw mip·pîw wə·lō- yin·hă·rū ’ê·lāw ‘ō·wḏ gō·w·yim gam- ḥō·w·maṯ bā·ḇel nā·p̄ā·lāh
verses.literal: I will punish . . . Bel in Babylon I will make him spew out - what he swallowed The nations will no longer stream to him even the wall of Babylon will fall
verses.literalPt: E castigarei a Bel em Babilônia, e tirarei da sua boca o que tragou, e nunca mais concorrerão a ele as nações; também o muro de Babilônia caiu.

verses.original: צְא֤וּ מִתּוֹכָהּ֙ עַמִּ֔י וּמַלְּט֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ מֵחֲר֖וֹן אַף־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·’ū mit·tō·w·ḵāh ‘am·mî ū·mal·lə·ṭū ’îš ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Come out of her My people Save your lives each of you from the fierce anger of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Saí do meio dela, ó povo meu, e livrai cada um a sua alma do ardor da ira do SENHOR.

verses.original: וּפֶן־ יֵרַ֤ךְ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְתִֽירְא֔וּ בַּשְּׁמוּעָ֖ה הַנִּשְׁמַ֣עַת בָּאָ֑רֶץ וּבָ֧א בַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁמוּעָ֗ה וְאַחֲרָ֤יו בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הַשְּׁמוּעָ֔ה וְחָמָ֣ס בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֹשֵׁ֖ל עַל־ מֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄en- yê·raḵ lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·ṯî·rə·’ū baš·šə·mū·‘āh han·niš·ma·‘aṯ bā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇā ḇaš·šā·nāh haš·šə·mū·‘āh wə·’a·ḥă·rāw baš·šā·nāh haš·šə·mū·‘āh wə·ḥā·mās bā·’ā·reṣ ū·mō·šêl ‘al- mō·šêl
verses.literal: Do not let your heart grow faint and do not be afraid when the rumor is heard in the land for a rumor will come one year and then another the next year of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler
verses.literalPt: E para que porventura não se enterneça o vosso coração, e não temais pelo rumor que se ouvir na terra; porque virá num ano um rumor, e depois noutro ano outro rumor; e haverá violência na terra, dominador contra dominador.

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וּפָקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־ פְּסִילֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְכָל־ אַרְצָ֖הּ תֵּב֑וֹשׁ וְכָל־ חֲלָלֶ֖יהָ יִפְּל֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- pə·sî·lê ḇā·ḇel wə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣāh tê·ḇō·wōš wə·ḵāl ḥă·lā·le·hā yip·pə·lū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming when I will punish . . . the idols of Babylon Her entire land will suffer shame and all her slain will lie fallen within her
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, em que farei juízo sobre as imagens de escultura de Babilônia, e toda a sua terra será envergonhada, e todos os seus mortos cairão no meio dela.

verses.original: וְרִנְּנ֤וּ עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֔רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם כִּ֧י מִצָּפ֛וֹן יָבוֹא־ לָ֥הּ הַשּׁוֹדְדִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rin·nə·nū ‘al- bā·ḇel šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bā·hem kî miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn yā·ḇō·w- lāh haš·šō·wḏ·ḏîm nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon because the destroyers from the north will come against her declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E os céus e a terra, com tudo quanto neles há, jubilarão sobre Babilônia; porque do norte lhe virão os destruidores, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: גַּם־ בָּבֶ֕ל לִנְפֹּ֖ל חַֽלְלֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־ לְבָבֶ֥ל נָפְל֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bā·ḇel lin·pōl ḥal·lê yiś·rā·’êl gam- lə·ḇā·ḇel nā·p̄ə·lū ḥal·lê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel just as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Como Babilônia fez cair mortos os de Israel, assim em Babilônia cairão os mortos de toda a terra.

verses.original: פְּלֵטִ֣ים מֵחֶ֔רֶב הִלְכ֖וּ אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ זִכְר֤וּ מֵֽרָחוֹק֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·lê·ṭîm mê·ḥe·reḇ hil·ḵū ’al- ta·‘ă·mō·ḏū ziḵ·rū mê·rā·ḥō·wq ’eṯ- Yah·weh wî·rū·šā·lim ta·‘ă·leh ‘al- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: You who have escaped the sword depart and do not linger Remember the LORD from far away and let Jerusalem come to mind
verses.literalPt: Vós, que escapastes da espada, ide-vos, não pareis; de longe lembrai-vos do SENHOR, e suba Jerusalém a vossa mente.

verses.original: בֹּ֚שְׁנוּ כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ חֶרְפָּ֔ה כִּסְּתָ֥ה כְלִמָּ֖ה פָּנֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֚י בָּ֣אוּ זָרִ֔ים עַֽל־ מִקְדְּשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bō·šə·nū kî- šā·ma‘·nū ḥer·pāh kis·sə·ṯāh ḵə·lim·māh pā·nê·nū kî bā·’ū zā·rîm ‘al- miq·də·šê bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: We are ashamed because we have heard reproach disgrace has covered our faces because foreigners have entered . . . the holy places of the LORD’s house
verses.literalPt: Direis: Envergonhados estamos, porque ouvimos opróbrio; vergonha cobriu o nosso rosto, porquanto vieram estrangeiros contra os santuários da casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֖י עַל־ פְּסִילֶ֑יהָ וּבְכָל־ אַרְצָ֖הּ יֶאֱנֹ֥ק חָלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- pə·sî·le·hā ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣāh ye·’ĕ·nōq ḥā·lāl
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will punish . . . her idols and throughout her land the wounded will groan
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que farei juízo sobre as suas imagens de escultura; e gemerão os feridos em toda a sua terra.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַעֲלֶ֤ה בָבֶל֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְכִ֥י תְבַצֵּ֖ר מְר֣וֹם עֻזָּ֑הּ מֵאִתִּ֗י יָבֹ֧אוּ שֹׁדְדִ֛ים לָ֖הּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯa·‘ă·leh ḇā·ḇel haš·šā·ma·yim wə·ḵî ṯə·ḇaṣ·ṣêr mə·rō·wm ‘uz·zāh mê·’it·tî yā·ḇō·’ū šō·ḏə·ḏîm lāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens . . . and fortifies her lofty stronghold the destroyers I send will come against her declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ainda que Babilônia subisse aos céus, e ainda que fortificasse a altura da sua fortaleza, todavia de mim virão destruidores sobre ela, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל זְעָקָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl zə·‘ā·qāh mib·bā·ḇel wə·še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl mê·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm
verses.literal: The sound of a cry comes from Babylon the sound of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: De Babilônia se ouve clamor de grande destruição da terra dos caldeus;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאִבַּ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְהָמ֤וּ גַלֵּיהֶם֙ כְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים נִתַּ֥ן שְׁא֖וֹן קוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šō·ḏêḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- bā·ḇel wə·’ib·baḏ mim·men·nāh qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl wə·hā·mū ḡal·lê·hem kə·ma·yim rab·bîm nit·tan šə·’ō·wn qō·w·lām
verses.literal: For the LORD will destroy Babylon He will silence . . . her mighty voice The waves will roar like great waters the tumult of their voices will resound
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR tem destruído Babilônia, e tem feito perecer nela a sua grande voz; quando as suas ondas bramam como muitas águas, é emitido o ruído da sua voz.

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָ֨א עָלֶ֤יהָ עַל־ בָּבֶל֙ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד וְנִלְכְּדוּ֙ גִּבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ חִתְּתָ֖ה קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֧ל גְּמֻל֛וֹת יְהוָ֖ה שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇā ‘ā·le·hā ‘al- bā·ḇel šō·w·ḏêḏ wə·nil·kə·ḏū gib·bō·w·re·hā ḥit·tə·ṯāh qaš·šə·ṯō·w·ṯām kî ’êl gə·mu·lō·wṯ Yah·weh šal·lêm yə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: For a destroyer is coming against her against Babylon Her warriors will be captured and their bows will be broken for the LORD is a God of retribution He will repay in full . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque o destruidor vem sobre ela, sobre Babilônia, e os seus poderosos serão presos, já estão quebrados os seus arcos; porque o SENHOR, Deus das recompensas, certamente lhe retribuirá.

verses.original: וְ֠הִשְׁכַּרְתִּי שָׂרֶ֨יהָ וַחֲכָמֶ֜יהָ פַּחוֹתֶ֤יהָ וּסְגָנֶ֙יהָ֙ וְגִבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֨ם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·kar·tî śā·re·hā wa·ḥă·ḵā·me·hā pa·ḥō·w·ṯe·hā ū·sə·ḡā·ne·hā wə·ḡib·bō·w·re·hā wə·yā·šə·nū šə·naṯ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·lō yā·qî·ṣū nə·’um- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: I will make her princes and wise men drunk along with her governors officials and warriors Then they will fall asleep . . . forever and not wake up declares the King whose name is the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: E embriagarei os seus príncipes, e os seus sábios e os seus capitães, e os seus magistrados, e os seus poderosos; e dormirão um sono eterno, e não acordarão, diz o Rei, cujo nome é o SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת חֹ֠מוֹת בָּבֶ֤ל הָֽרְחָבָה֙ עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר וּשְׁעָרֶ֥יהָ הַגְּבֹהִ֖ים בָּאֵ֣שׁ יִצַּ֑תּוּ וְיִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּדֵי־ רִ֛יק וּלְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּדֵי־ אֵ֖שׁ וְיָעֵֽפוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ḥō·mō·wṯ bā·ḇel hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh ‘ar·‘êr tiṯ·‘ar·‘ār ū·šə·‘ā·re·hā hag·gə·ḇō·hîm bā·’êš yiṣ·ṣat·tū wə·yiḡ·‘ū ‘am·mîm bə·ḏê- rîq ū·lə·’um·mîm bə·ḏê- ’êš wə·yā·‘ê·p̄ū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Babylon’s thick walls will be leveled . . . and her high gates consumed by fire So the labor of the people will be for nothing the nations . . . will exhaust themselves to fuel the flames
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Os largos muros de Babilônia serão totalmente derrubados, e as suas altas portas serão abrasadas pelo fogo; e trabalharão os povos em vão, e as nações no fogo, e eles se cansarão.

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה׀ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא אֶת־ שְׂרָיָ֣ה בֶן־ נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־ מַחְסֵיָה֒ בְּלֶכְתּ֞וֹ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֥ת הָרְבִעִ֖ית לְמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה שַׂ֥ר מְנוּחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ’eṯ- śə·rā·yāh ḇen- nê·rî·yāh ben- maḥ·sê·yāh bə·leḵ·tōw ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh bā·ḇel biš·naṯ hā·rə·ḇi·‘îṯ lə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·śə·rā·yāh śar mə·nū·ḥāh
verses.literal: This is the message that Jeremiah the prophet gave to the quartermaster Seraiah son of Neriah the son of Mahseiah when he went to Babylon with King Zedekiah of Judah in the fourth year of Zedekiah’s reign
verses.literalPt: A palavra que Jeremias, o profeta, mandou a Seraías, filho de Nerias, filho de Maaséias, indo ele com Zedequias, rei de Judá, a Babilônia, no quarto ano do seu reinado. E Seraías era o camareiro-mor.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־ סֵ֣פֶר אֶחָ֑ד אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים אֶל־ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ yir·mə·yā·hū ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- tā·ḇō·w ’el- bā·ḇel ’el- sê·p̄er ’e·ḥāḏ ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh hak·kə·ṯu·ḇîm ’el- bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Jeremiah had written on a single scroll about all the disaster that would come upon Babylon all these words that had been written concerning Babylon
verses.literalPt: Escreveu, pois, Jeremias num livro todo o mal que havia de vir sobre Babilônia, a saber, todas estas palavras que estavam escritas contra Babilônia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־ שְׂרָיָ֑ה כְּבֹאֲךָ֣ בָבֶ֔ל וְֽרָאִ֔יתָ וְֽקָרָ֔אתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- śə·rā·yāh kə·ḇō·’ă·ḵā ḇā·ḇel wə·rā·’î·ṯā wə·qā·rā·ṯā ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah When you get to Babylon see that you read all these words aloud
verses.literalPt: E disse Jeremias a Seraías: Quando chegares a Babilônia, verás e lerás todas estas palavras.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ יְהוָה֙ אַתָּ֨ה דִבַּ֜רְתָּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ לְהַכְרִית֔וֹ לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֱיֽוֹת־ בּוֹ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב לְמֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה כִּֽי־ שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā Yah·weh ’at·tāh ḏib·bar·tā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh lə·haḵ·rî·ṯōw lə·ḇil·tî hĕ·yō·wṯ- bōw yō·wō·šêḇ lə·mê·’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh kî- šim·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh
verses.literal: and say O LORD You have promised . . . to cut off this place so that no one will remain neither man nor beast Indeed it will be desolate forever
verses.literalPt: E dirás: SENHOR, tu falaste contra este lugar, que o havias de desarraigar, até não ficar nele morador algum, nem homem nem animal, e que se tornaria em perpétua desolação.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּכַלֹּ֣תְךָ֔ לִקְרֹ֖א אֶת־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה תִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ אֶ֔בֶן וְהִשְׁלַכְתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ תּ֥וֹךְ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ḵal·lō·ṯə·ḵā liq·rō ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh tiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw ’e·ḇen wə·hiš·laḵ·tōw ’el- tō·wḵ pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: When you finish reading this scroll tie a stone to it and cast it into . . . the Euphrates
verses.literalPt: E será que, acabando tu de ler este livro, atar-lhe-ás uma pedra e lançá-lo-ás no meio do Eufrates.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כָּ֠כָה תִּשְׁקַ֨ע בָּבֶ֤ל וְלֹֽא־ תָקוּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ וְיָעֵ֑פוּ עַד־ הֵ֖נָּה דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kā·ḵāh tiš·qa‘ bā·ḇel wə·lō- ṯā·qūm mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî ‘ā·le·hā wə·yā·‘ê·p̄ū ‘aḏ- hên·nāh diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū
verses.literal: Then you are to say In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again because of the disaster I will bring upon her And her people will grow weary Here end the words of Jeremiah
verses.literalPt: E dirás: Assim será afundada Babilônia, e não se levantará, por causa do mal que eu hei de trazer sobre ela; e eles se cansarão. Até aqui são as palavras de Jeremias.
